name: nyamuru-voice-v0.5.1-fixed-data-training-method-comparison
selection_metric: dev macro_f1 over all 19 labels with zero division=0; all 19 labels have support
selection: Best reused-dev epoch per seed/LR; shared LR by mean best-dev macro F1 over seeds. Then method by its selected-LR mean dev macro F1; ties lower dev CE, earlier mean epoch, declared condition order. Freeze primary seed from the selected method before regression predictions.
split_limitation: All data is byte-identical to v0.4. Dev68 is reused for method/epoch/LR selection. Test73 and four legacy splits have already been inspected and are regression-only. Independent unseen real-user/ASR evaluation remains pending.
adoption: No automatic production adoption or application dispatch.
source_review: Source row provenance and parent semantic review recorded separately; individual user review pending.
primary_selection: Highest reused-dev macro F1 among selected seeds; lower ordinary dev CE, earlier epoch, earlier trial. Method selected by mean best dev macro F1 across seeds, before any regression predictions.
numerical_patch: symmetric KL with log targets; zero coefficient excludes KL backward path
